summary: Restoration pledges seek a 5% mangrove expansion by 2030 relative to 2018. Mixed marine–AFOLU commitments seek a 5% mangrove expansion by 2035 relative to 2022 and a 1.6% rise in forest cover, about 16.0 km² of the 999 km² forest (35.1% of land) mapped in 2022; another pledge targets 2% forest growth by 2030 relative to 2013. Conservation commitments expand Central Savaii Rainforest protection from 13.3% to 50% by 2035, extend community aquaculture or fisheries management to 60% of 310 villages (186), and establish three national fisheries service hubs. Agriculture targets include an additional 5% of agricultural land under agroforestry by 2030, adoption by 30% of commercial and community-based farms, and at least three crop varieties by 2035; an undated passage separately states at least five crop varieties. For scale, 5% of the current 1,802 km² agricultural area (63.3% of land) is 90.1 km².
